messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 — Elevated 5xx error rate detected on streaming-gateway us-west-2. Metric: streaming_gateway.response.5xx_rate = 18% over 2m (baseline 0.5%). Affected route: /v1/stream (fanout). Potential customer impact: clients see truncated streams or connection resets.
ashwin: ack — taking ownership. oncall runbook brought up. tagging @maria for infra help and @joel for runtime.
maria: looking. initial quick glance at metrics — gateway upstream 502/503 spike aligns with a deployment window ~3m ago. checking envoy/nginx error rates and tcp resets.
joel: can someone grab a sample request id for an affected stream? need headers + last chunk seen.
katy: support alerted customer-bob (enterprise) — they report partial transcripts and 2xx->reset in client after ~8-12s. Customer says happens ~30% of long streams.
ashwin: ok, mitigation plan: 1) route critical enterprise traffic to fallback region/cluster (us-east-1) 2) enable gateway degraded-mode (preserve non-streaming tokens) 3) roll back the midnight routing change if safe. maria, can you open failover and check capacity?
maria: starting cross-region route flip for customer-bob now (will mark as in-progress). also increasing gateway worker count + temporarily relaxing concurrency throttle for streaming. watching health.
joel: while that's in progress, I'm going to check runtime logs for chunked encoding errors — suspecting fragmented frames / premature FIN. grep for "unexpected EOF" and "chunked" in the runtime logs.
infra-bot: Deploy hook: 2026-03-15T02:03:10Z — rollout of gateway-proxy v2.14.7 completed to us-west-2. Rolling pods: 8 -> 8.
ashwin: that rollout timestamp matches when the spike started. joel, check if v2.14.7 introduced any header/keepalive behavior changes.
joel: confirm — v2.14.7 included upstream keepalive tuning and a minor change to chunked flush behavior (commit 5a9b3). I'm running a targeted log query:
```
# show last 15m runtime errors with request id
rg "unexpected EOF|client canceled|chunked encoding error|write of pipe" /var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log | tail -n 200
```
joel: found multiple entries referencing "chunked frame truncated" and "write: connection reset by peer" from proxy ip 10.3.45.12 around 02:06:xx. Looks correlated.
ashwin: maria, can you temporarily put us-west-2 gateway on canary-backoff (stop new rollouts) and scale down v2.14.7 pods to previous revision while we validate rollback? If we can reduce new errors quickly that confirms deploy regression.
maria: doing a controlled rollback to gateway-proxy v2.14.6 on three nodes now (auto-scaling suspended). will post when stable.
katy: customer-bob sees improvement after routing to us-east-1 — still some truncation but rate dropped from 30% -> ~6% per their telemetry. telling them we're investigating root cause and will update in 15m.
joel: also found client cancellations that look normal (user hitting stop) but distinct set showing "trailer missing" which is likely server-side chunk truncation.
nashwin: good note. if it's server-side we need mitigation on the runtime layer too — joel, can you enable a quick guard that retries a single token on connection reset before surface error? might mask partial token loss but reduce perceived truncation.
joel: can push a hotfix patch to runtime to swallow a small set of transient EOFs and perform one transparent reconnect for long-running streams. Will ship to canary only.
infrastructure: autoscaler: increased desired replicas +10 for us-west-2 stream-gateway.
maria: rollback completed on nodes 2/3/3 (partial partitioning) — traffic still migrating. error rate trending down from 18% -> 7% in the last 3m.
ashwin: nice. keep rollback and routing failover in place until postmortem. assign owners: @maria infra rollback + capacity, @joel runtime patch, @katy CS comms and customer follow-up.
katy: noted. I've got customer-bob on a scheduled 30m check-in, will collect logs and a capture of their client-side socket close sequence.
joel: pushing canary for runtime hotfix now. hash: hotfix-eof-retry-20260315. will monitor 1% of traffic.
maria: watchlist: envoy upstream timeouts also spiked — check kernel tcp_retries and socket backlog (epoll) on gateway hosts. I'm SSHing into host-10-3-45-12 to run `ss -s` and `dmesg | tail`.
ashwin: escalation decision: if rollback + routing + hotfix don't bring errors <2% in 20m, we'll open a P1 and involve platform-sre pager. Right now trending positive.
katy: customer-bob reported streams are much better after failover; they can proceed with test flight. Will keep monitoring.
joel: canary hotfix looks clean so far — no crash, and the one-off reconnect reduced truncated responses in the canary bucket.
ashwin: great. steps for post-incident: 1) full rollback verification across all nodes 2) root cause: analyze v2.14.7 change in chunk flush + keepalive interaction 3) add unit/integration test for chunked trailer preservation and streaming reconnect 4) customer postmortem note + RCA.
maria: collecting logs and preserving nodes for forensic. snapshotting /var/log and kernel traces.
ashwin: any immediate customer-impacting follow-ups?
katy: no new reports. CS will update customer-bob at 02:40Z and offer a postmortem once RCA done.
joel: filing PR for hotfix backport to stable branch and adding a regression test harness that simulates intermittent FIN mid-chunk.
ashwin: thanks team. leaving notes on the incident board and will convert this thread into an incident doc. If anyone sees regression ping here. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident state: partial mitigation in place — error rate decreased. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes.
